Madras High Court Upholds Speaker's Acceptance of AIADMK MLA Resignations

The Madras High Court has upheld the Tamil Nadu Assembly Speaker's decision to accept the resignations of six AIADMK MLAs. The court ruled that the resignations were valid and voluntary, and that the Speaker's acceptance was constitutionally appropriate under the Tenth Schedule of the Constitution. The court also clarified that resignation and disqualification are separate constitutional processes.
